query: Consider the following context: High entropy alloys have excellent wear resistance, so they have great application prospects in the fields of wear resistance and surface protection. In that context, which material can be used for adhere to the surface of a Cu matrix, and why?

generation.hypothesis: A WVTaTiCr x RHEAs coating can be used to adhere to the surface of a Cu matrix due to its high-temperature oxidation resistance and hardness.
generation.mechanism: Formation of a dense oxidation film on the surface of the alloy
generation.predicted_outcome: Improved high-temperature oxidation resistance and wear resistance
generation.uncertainty: The exact composition and thickness of the WVTaTiCr x RHEAs coating may affect its performance

falsification_experiment.design: Compare the high-temperature oxidation resistance and wear resistance of a Cu matrix with and without a WVTaTiCr x RHEAs coating
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the Cu matrix with the WVTaTiCr x RHEAs coating does not show improved high-temperature oxidation resistance and wear resistance compared to the Cu matrix without the coating, the hypothesis is falsified
